say:2:1523205001:0.text: How useless! You lot can't even handle an unarmed mage! No wonder you are no match for those filthy Wildborn!
say:2:1523205001:0.source_cn: 一群废物……竟然连一个手无寸铁的魔法师都拦不住！难怪会...

say:3:1523205002:1.text: Don't blame the soldiers! They were starving before the truce agreement was signed. How could they have stood against the Wildborn?
say:3:1523205002:1.source_cn: 何必指责这些无辜的士兵？在殿下签署停战合约之前，他们甚...

say:4:1523205003:1.text: We'd still have nothing to eat now if it weren't for the Regulus! You need to see how short-sighted you are!
say:4:1523205003:1.source_cn: 如果不是阿邦德殿下暂时妥协，呼临城连如今这些食物都没有...

say:5:1523205004:1.text: Reconciling with the Wildborn is our only choice for the time being.
say:5:1523205004:1.source_cn: 与雅库伯尔和解，是呼临当下唯一的选择。

say:6:1523205005:1.text: We're compromising now for the sake of our future!
say:6:1523205005:1.source_cn: 停战合约中的退让只是暂时的，阿邦德殿下所做的一切都是为...

say:7:1523205006:1.text: Future? If it means living under the Wildborn's shadows, it isn't a future worth having!
say:7:1523205006:1.source_cn: 未来？世世代代受到兽人的掣肘，在兽人的施舍下过活，这算...

say:8:1523205007:1.text: Bakis, you were once in favor of fighting the Wildborn. I believe you can figure out a way forward.
say:8:1523205007:1.source_cn: 比博，你以前也是支持讨伐兽人的，是个明事理的人，不会想...

say:9:1523205008:1.text: You're just too stuck in your old ways, supporting the Regulus and holding onto old traditions.
say:9:1523205008:1.source_cn: 你只是被那些陈腐的思维困住了脚步。你习惯了支持领主、支...

say:11:1523205010:1.text: Listen, it isn't hard to annul the agreement. Once <style="highlight">Regulus Abundius steps down</style>, we can contest the legality of the agreement he signed.
say:11:1523205010:1.source_cn: 撕毁停战合约并非难事，只要<style=highlig...

say:12:1523205011:1.text: That way, we can regain control of the wheat and shape our own future!
say:12:1523205011:1.source_cn: 如此一来，呼临就能把麦种重新拿到自己手里，才有未来可谈！

say:13:1523205012:1.text: ... What are you saying?! Regulus Abundius is the only heir of Regulus Herennus! How could you even propose his abdication?!
say:13:1523205012:1.source_cn: ……你说什么？！阿邦德殿下是赫伦尼殿下唯一的继承人！你...

say:14:1523205013:1.source_cn: 是，他是赫伦尼殿下唯一的孩子，可那又怎样？

say:15:1523205014:1.text: From this agreement, it's safe to say he hasn't inherited the wisdom of his father.
say:15:1523205014:1.source_cn: 事实证明，他没有继承前任领主的英明，只是个不懂事的孩子。

say:16:1523205015:1.text: He's a coward who hands our fate over to the Wildborn.
say:16:1523205015:1.source_cn: 他贪生怕死，将食物拱手交给兽人，签下合约，任凭野兽掌控...

say:17:1523205016:1.text: Our people's welfare comes before him!
say:17:1523205016:1.source_cn: 呼临城的民众，远比阿邦德这个人更重要！

say:18:1523205017:1.text: I'd give my right arm to protect Halia's future!
say:18:1523205017:1.source_cn: 为了撕毁停战合约，为了呼临城民众的未来，我没有什么不能...

say:19:1523205018:1.text: I... don't even know where to start! You're not thinking about the consequences!
say:19:1523205018:1.source_cn: 你……你！你根本没有考虑过后果！

say:20:1523205019:1.text: If we renege on the agreement, the Wildborn will turn against us at any time!
say:20:1523205019:1.source_cn: 推翻停战条约，雅库伯尔同样能向呼临发难！

say:21:1523205020:1.text: If we destroy that bridge across the rift, they'll have no way to reach us!
say:21:1523205020:1.source_cn: 只要那座连通深壑的大桥不复存在，他们就没法再踏足呼临的土地！

say:22:1523205021:1.text: How foolish! They can simply rebuild the bridge!
say:22:1523205021:1.source_cn: 呼临能够建造桥梁，雅库伯尔难道不能吗？！

say:23:1523205022:1.text: Once they cross the Taothos Rift, we'll be doomed!
say:23:1523205022:1.source_cn: 一旦他们渡过了塔欧妥斯深壑，呼临将面临灭顶之灾！

say:24:1523205023:1.text: Even so, it's better than doing nothing and letting the Wildborn seize our city!
say:24:1523205023:1.source_cn: 那也比毫不挣扎，等着被兽人接管呼临城要好！

say:25:1523205024:1.text: You're as stubborn as a mule!

say:26:1523205025:1.text: Right back at you, you old rascal!
say:26:1523205025:1.source_cn: 这话该是我骂你用的！你个臭老头！

say:27:1523205026:1.text: Go on, kill me now if you dare! Let's see if Regulus Herennus doesn't haunt your nights!
say:27:1523205026:1.source_cn: 有本事你现在就杀死我，看看你对不对得起赫伦尼殿下的遗愿！

narration:29:1523205028:0.text: Out of spite, Bakis grabs a sword from a soldier.
narration:29:1523205028:0.source_cn: 比博愤怒地抢来一名士兵腰间的佩剑

narration:30:1523205029:0.text: Gripping the hilt tightly, he hesitates to draw the sword out.
narration:30:1523205029:0.source_cn: 他握紧了剑柄，面对着奥勒留，却迟迟没有将它完全拔出

say:31:1523205030:1.text: ... Regulus Herennus wanted both of us to counsel his son. If not for his final wish, I wouldn't forgive your insolent words.
say:31:1523205030:1.source_cn: ……如果不是赫伦尼殿下看重你，临终前还命令你我辅佐阿邦...

say:33:1523205032:1.text: Mull over what I said, Bakis. I'm just trying to do what's right.
say:33:1523205032:1.source_cn: 好好想想我说的话吧，比博。这就是最合理的解决方法。

say:37:1523205034:1.text: ... Aurelin's always been a headstrong man.
say:37:1523205034:1.source_cn: ……奥勒留生性固执，从很多年前就是这样。
say:37:1523205034:1.male: ... Aurelin's always been a headstrong man.
say:37:1523205034:1.female: ... Aurelin's always been a headstrong man.

say:38:1523205035:1.text: Can't believe he's pushing for the Regulus' abdication... He must have gone daft!
say:38:1523205035:1.source_cn: 他真是老糊涂了……竟然想让殿下退位，这是什么昏招！
say:38:1523205035:1.male: Can't believe he's pushing for the Regulus' abdication... He must have gone daft!
say:38:1523205035:1.female: Can't believe he's pushing for the Regulus' abdication... He must have gone daft!

say:39:1523205036:1.text: <style="highlight">The Regulus must know about this</style>. We have no time to lose!
say:39:1523205036:1.source_cn: 事态紧急，不能让阿邦德殿下蒙在鼓里。快些回去，<sty...
say:39:1523205036:1.male: <style="highlight">The Regulus must know about this</style>. We have no time to lose!
say:39:1523205036:1.female: <style="highlight">The Regulus must know about this</style>. We have no time to lose!

choice:36:1:2.text: Looks like the negotiation has fallen through.
choice:36:1:2.male: Looks like the negotiation has fallen through.
choice:36:1:2.female: Looks like the negotiation has fallen through.
